title: AI Property Auto-Furnish Image Generator
desc:
Built a production AI system for a UK real-estate client that takes empty room photographs and automatically generates photorealistic fully-furnished versions using generative deep learning models.

The system handles bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and living rooms — producing staging-quality outputs that replace thousands of dollars in physical staging costs. This was a fully paid client deliverable built end-to-end: from model training to processing pipeline to final delivery.

title: Full Match Ball Tracker & Score Analyzer
desc:
Complete end-to-end computer vision pipeline that tracks every player on the pitch, follows the ball in real-time, keeps team scores, and provides tactical analysis.

Uses YOLOv8 for player and ball detection, with custom tracking algorithms for identity persistence across frames even through occlusion. A full analytics overlay renders bounding boxes, player IDs, ball trajectory, and live score — processed at real-time speeds.
main: assets/my projects/[advanced]full football team score ball tracker and analyzer.mp4

title: Sports Activity Recognition, Analyzer & Classifier
desc:
Complex end-to-end system that recognizes and classifies 12+ exercises in real-time: push-ups, squats, bicep curls, bench press, dips, pull-ups, shoulder press, pectoral flies, rowing, and more.

Uses MediaPipe for skeletal pose estimation, feeding joint angles and velocities into a custom-trained classifier. Counts reps, evaluates form quality, and provides real-time coaching feedback. One of my most technically demanding builds — handling variable body types, camera angles, and exercise variations.

title: Squid Game 3D — Full Game in Python
desc:
Full 3D recreation of the Squid Game "Red Light, Green Light" challenge built entirely in Python using the Ursina engine. Features 3D character models, real-time motion detection mechanics, custom shaders, dynamic lighting, and a complete game loop with scoring and elimination logic.

Demonstrates that Python can power full, visually rich 3D games — not just scripts.
main: assets/my projects/[complex]squid game 3d made using ursina python.mp4

title: Real-Time Violence Detection System
desc:
AI-powered real-time violence detection system that analyzes live video streams and classifies violent behavior using deep learning CNNs trained on custom datasets.

Processes video frames through a temporal analysis pipeline to reduce false positives. Designed for security and surveillance applications with real-time alerting. The system distinguishes between violent and non-violent motion patterns even in crowded scenes.

title: Document Scanner with Full GUI
desc:
Desktop document scanner application with a complete GUI interface. Uses OpenCV for edge detection, perspective transformation, and adaptive thresholding to produce clean, flat scans from angled photos taken with any camera.

The Tkinter GUI supports drag-and-drop, real-time edge preview, manual corner adjustment, and multi-format export. Handles documents, receipts, handwritten notes, and books.
main: assets/my projects/[medium] document scanner with full GUI.mp4

title: Client Website — Full Build
desc:
Complete responsive website designed and built from scratch for a paying client. Features smooth animations, modern UI/UX design, full mobile optimization, and cross-browser compatibility.

Delivered as a production client project with clean code, optimized assets, and full documentation. Demonstrates ability to handle client requirements, revisions, and professional delivery.

title: Face Segmentizer — Auto Passport Photo Generator
desc:
Automated passport photo generator that detects faces, segments them from any background using deep learning segmentation models, crops precisely to standard passport dimensions, applies regulatory compliance checks, and outputs print-ready images.

Handles varying lighting conditions, backgrounds, face angles, and expressions. Can batch-process multiple images automatically.
main: assets/my projects/[advanced[face sementizer for automatch passport image generator.png

title: Multiplayer Platformer — Pygame + Networking
desc:
Complete 2D platformer game with real-time multiplayer networking over Python sockets. Features custom sprite animation, tile-based level design from a level editor, collectible items, enemy AI with pathfinding, a custom physics engine, and synchronized multiplayer gameplay.

Players can join or host games over a local network. Demonstrates deep understanding of game architecture, network programming, and Python performance optimization.
main: assets/my projects/[advanced]full platform multiplayer game using pygame python/project.png

title: OpenGL 3D Rendering Demo
desc:
3D graphics rendering system built with OpenGL and Python. Features real-time 3D object rendering, camera controls, dynamic lighting with multiple light sources, and custom GLSL shader implementation.

Demonstrates fundamental understanding of the graphics pipeline, vertex/fragment shaders, transformation matrices, and GPU-accelerated rendering — the foundation of all real-time 3D graphics.

title: Real-Time Motion Detection
desc:
Real-time motion detection system using OpenCV with frame differencing, Gaussian blur, threshold-based contour detection, and bounding box visualization on live webcam feeds.

Features configurable sensitivity, motion zone selection, and visual alerting. Runs efficiently on standard hardware with minimal CPU usage. This was the foundational project that led to the more complex sports and surveillance systems.

title: Human Pose Estimation
desc:
Real-time human pose estimation and 33-point skeletal tracking using MediaPipe Pose and OpenCV. Detects body landmarks including joints, connects them into a full skeleton overlay rendered over the live camera feed.

This project was the foundation for the Sports Activity Recognition system — understanding pose data, joint angles, and velocity vectors before building the full classifier on top.

title: Next Gen Camera System
desc:
An AI security layer for existing CCTV — it spots robbers, fire, faints, faces & anomalies in real time and acts (buzzer + calls/alerts) instead of just recording.

Five custom detection modules — robbery, fire, faint, drowsiness and face recognition — run on a live video pipeline built with OpenCV and deep learning, wired to hardware alerts. Presented at INEX India, the Bihar Innovation Challenge (1st Prize), BIT Mesra, and to international research delegates. In development since class 7.

title: vit — My Own Programming Language
desc:
A hand-written lexer, parser and executer with its own keyword system and source-cache format. Not a wrapper, not a transpiler — an interpreted language built from nothing, in Python.

Programs live in .vit source files that run through the full pipeline: tokenize, parse, execute, cache. Building a language end to end forces you to understand how every language you use actually works underneath.

title: Next Gen Parking — Single-Camera Smart Parking
desc:
One camera replaces a sensor per parking spot — real-time free/occupied detection using pure classical computer vision. No neural network anywhere in the pipeline, and that's the point.

Won 1st prize at the IIT Delhi innovation challenge with a polished physical demo. Knowing when NOT to reach for a model is a computer-vision skill too.
main: assets/1st postion in IIT delhi innovation challlenge - NextGenParkingSystem.mp4

title: AI Virtual Teacher — a Voice "Video Call"
desc:
Speech recognition, an intent matcher and TTS running as separate processes passing messages through files — I reinvented message queues before I knew threads existed.

Built in 2021 and preserved as originally written — the code is a snapshot of how a 14-year-old solves inter-process communication from first principles.

title: Foci — Study Planner & Focus App
desc:
Daily timeline, focus timer, lofi player, stats and rewards across 8 themes — built to run my own discipline system, then shipped with a landing page.

Open-source Windows desktop app: software built to serve a routine I actually live by, not a portfolio piece that only exists in screenshots.

title: JEE Horizon — AI E-Learning Platform
desc:
A live, shipped product: an AI-powered e-learning platform where students solve practice questions, get AI help when they're stuck, and compete against each other on the leaderboard.

Built full-stack and deployed — question bank, solving flow, AI assistance, competitive scoring and user accounts, all running in production on Firebase. Not a demo, not a repo: a real platform with real users.
